reason: Alert 1 alert-unclear: User input flows to URL.openStream(), but there is a DNS resolution check (isNonPublicAddress) that filters out loopback/site-local/link-local/any-local addresses. However, the check only validates the resolved IP at parse time, while the actual fetch uses the original hostname string - creating a potential DNS rebinding window. Also, the validation doesn't cover all internal address types (e.g., private IPv4 ranges like 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x aren't caught by isSiteLocalAddress/isLinkLocalAddress). Whether this is exploitable depends on DNS TTL behavior and network policies not visible in code.

evidence.note: User param flows to URL openStream, with isNonPublicAddress check on resolved host
